//@version=6
indicator("[QUANT] Liquidity Zones", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. SETTINGS & INPUTS
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
grp_snr  = "Structure Settings"
grp_ema  = "Trend Confluence (EMA)"
grp_disp = "Display & Colors"
grp_dash = "Dashboard Settings"

// --- Structure Inputs ---
lookback       = input.int(10,   "Structure Lookback",    minval=5, group=grp_snr,
     tooltip="Bars to the left/right to define a pivot. Higher = stronger, longer-term levels.")
max_zones      = input.int(10,   "Max Active Zones",      group=grp_snr,
     tooltip="Total cap on stored zones before old ones are dropped.")
atr_period     = input.int(14,   "Zone Width (ATR)",      group=grp_snr)
atr_mult       = input.float(1.0,"ATR Multiplier",        group=grp_snr)
show_bk        = input.bool(false, "Show Broken Zones?",  group=grp_snr)

// --- Overlap & Display Count ---
filter_overlap = input.bool(true,  "Hide Overlapping Zones", group=grp_snr,
     tooltip="Prevents creating a new zone if it overlaps an existing active zone of the same type.")
limit_display  = input.bool(true,  "Limit Visible Zones Per Side", group=grp_snr,
     tooltip="When enabled, only the N highest-probability zones per side are drawn.")
display_count  = input.int(3,      "Zones to Show Per Side", minval=1, maxval=10, group=grp_snr,
     tooltip="Number of resistance AND support zones shown. Probabilities split to sum to 100% across visible zones per side.")

// --- EMA Inputs ---
use_ema  = input.bool(false, "Enable Trend Filter (EMA)?", group=grp_ema,
     tooltip="Plots EMA lines and Buy/Sell signals to help confirm structure entries.")
len_fast = input.int(9,  "Fast EMA Length", group=grp_ema)
len_slow = input.int(21, "Slow EMA Length", group=grp_ema)

// --- Colors ---
c_res   = input.color(#ef4444, "Resistance Color",         group=grp_disp)
c_sup   = input.color(#22c55e, "Support Color",            group=grp_disp)
c_top   = input.color(#f59e0b, "Top Zone Highlight Color", group=grp_disp,
     tooltip="Color applied to the single highest-probability zone on each side. Defaults to gold.")
c_fast  = input.color(color.white,  "Fast EMA Color", group=grp_disp)
c_slow  = input.color(color.yellow, "Slow EMA Color", group=grp_disp)

// --- Dashboard ---
show_dash  = input.bool(true, "Show Dashboard?",   group=grp_dash)
show_count = input.bool(true, "Show Zone Counts?", group=grp_dash,
     tooltip="Shows total active and visible zone counts in the dashboard.")
dash_pos   = input.string(position.top_right, "Dashboard Position",
     options=[position.top_right, position.top_left, position.bottom_right, position.bottom_left],
     group=grp_dash)


// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. ANCHOR
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot(close, display=display.none, editable=false)


// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3. TREND LOGIC (EMA)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ema_fast = ta.ema(close, len_fast)
ema_slow = ta.ema(close, len_slow)

plot(use_ema ? ema_fast : na, "Fast EMA", color=c_fast, linewidth=1)
plot(use_ema ? ema_slow : na, "Slow EMA", color=c_slow, linewidth=2)

bull_cross = ta.crossover(ema_fast, ema_slow)
bear_cross = ta.crossunder(ema_fast, ema_slow)

// Label arrays — keep only last 2 BUY and last 2 SELL signals
var array<label> buy_labels  = array.new_label()
var array<label> sell_labels = array.new_label()

if use_ema
    if bull_cross
        label lb = label.new(bar_index, low,  "BUY",
             style=label.style_label_up, color=c_sup,
             textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
        array.push(buy_labels, lb)
        // Delete oldest if more than 2
        while array.size(buy_labels) > 2
            label.delete(array.shift(buy_labels))

    if bear_cross
        label lb = label.new(bar_index, high, "SELL",
             style=label.style_label_down, color=c_res,
             textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
        array.push(sell_labels, lb)
        while array.size(sell_labels) > 2
            label.delete(array.shift(sell_labels))

// Clear all signal labels when EMA filter is turned off
if not use_ema
    if array.size(buy_labels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(buy_labels) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(buy_labels, i))
        array.clear(buy_labels)
    if array.size(sell_labels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(sell_labels) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(sell_labels, i))
        array.clear(sell_labels)


// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 4. STRUCTURE LOGIC
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ph  = ta.pivothigh(high, lookback, lookback)
pl  = ta.pivotlow(low,  lookback, lookback)
atr = ta.atr(atr_period)

// UDT — line+linefill gradient zones
type SnRLevel
    float    price
    float    sl_price
    float    raw_score   // internal ranking score (displacement-based, not shown)
    float    disp_pct    // displayed shared probability (sums to 100% per side)
    line     l_main
    line     l_sl
    linefill f_zone
    label    lbl
    bool     is_sell
    bool     is_active

var levels = array.new<SnRLevel>()

// --- Overlap check ---
is_overlapping(float price, float current_atr, bool is_sell) =>
    overlap = false
    float sl_dist = current_atr * atr_mult
    if array.size(levels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(levels) - 1
            lvl = array.get(levels, i)
            if lvl.is_active and lvl.is_sell == is_sell
                float upper = math.max(lvl.price, lvl.sl_price)
                float lower = math.min(lvl.price, lvl.sl_price)
                if price <= upper + sl_dist and price >= lower - sl_dist
                    overlap := true
                    break
    overlap

// --- Zone creation ---
// raw_score is a displacement-based value used purely for ranking.
// disp_pct (the shared %) is computed and updated later each bar.
create_level(float price, bool is_sell_setup, float current_atr) =>
    float sl_dist  = current_atr * atr_mult
    float sl_price = is_sell_setup ? (price + sl_dist) : (price - sl_dist)

    float displacement = math.abs(price - close)
    float disp_ratio   = displacement / current_atr
    // Raw score: higher = stronger/further displaced pivot (used for ranking only)
    float raw_score    = math.max(0.01, disp_ratio)

    color col_main = is_sell_setup ? c_res : c_sup
    color col_line = color.new(col_main, 0)
    color col_sl   = color.new(col_main, 55)
    color col_fill = color.new(col_main, 82)

    lbl_text = (is_sell_setup ? "SELL\n" : "BUY\n") + "—%"

    int t1 = time[lookback]
    int t2 = time

    line l_m = line.new(t1, price,    t2, price,
         xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=col_line, style=line.style_solid, width=2)
    line l_s = line.new(t1, sl_price, t2, sl_price,
         xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=col_sl,   style=line.style_dashed, width=1)
    linefill f_z = linefill.new(l_m, l_s, col_fill)

    label lb = label.new(t2, price, text=lbl_text,
         xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_none,
         textcolor=col_main, size=size.small)

    SnRLevel.new(price, sl_price, raw_score, 0.0, l_m, l_s, f_z, lb, is_sell_setup, true)

// --- Helper: fully hide a zone ---
f_hide_zone(SnRLevel lvl) =>
    color invis = color.new(color.black, 100)
    line.set_color(lvl.l_main,     invis)
    line.set_color(lvl.l_sl,       invis)
    linefill.set_color(lvl.f_zone, invis)
    label.set_text(lvl.lbl,        "")
    label.set_textcolor(lvl.lbl,   invis)

// --- Helper: apply color + shared probability label to a visible zone ---
// is_top = true  → use gold highlight color
// shared_pct     → the zone's share of 100% among visible zones on this side
f_apply_zone(SnRLevel lvl, float shared_pct, bool is_top) =>
    color col_main = is_top ? c_top : (lvl.is_sell ? c_res : c_sup)
    color col_line = color.new(col_main, 0)
    color col_sl   = color.new(col_main, is_top ? 30 : 55)
    // Top zone gets a richer fill; others fade proportionally to their share
    int fill_transp = is_top ? 72 : math.max(78, 92 - int(shared_pct * 0.18))
    color col_fill  = color.new(col_main, fill_transp)
    line.set_color(lvl.l_main,     col_line)
    line.set_color(lvl.l_sl,       col_sl)
    line.set_width(lvl.l_main,     is_top ? 3 : 2)
    linefill.set_color(lvl.f_zone, col_fill)
    string side_txt = lvl.is_sell ? "SELL" : "BUY"
    string top_mark = is_top ? " ★" : ""
    string lbl_text = side_txt + top_mark + "\n" + str.tostring(shared_pct, "#.1") + "%"
    label.set_text(lvl.lbl,      lbl_text)
    label.set_textcolor(lvl.lbl, col_main)

// --- Helper: Nth-highest raw_score cutoff for top-N filter ---
f_nth_score(array<float> scores, int n) =>
    float cutoff = 0.0
    int   sz     = array.size(scores)
    if sz > 0
        copy      = scores.copy()
        int limit = math.min(n, sz)
        for k = 0 to limit - 1
            int bestIdx = k
            if k < sz - 1
                for j = k + 1 to sz - 1
                    if array.get(copy, j) > array.get(copy, bestIdx)
                        bestIdx := j
            if bestIdx != k
                float tmp = array.get(copy, k)
                array.set(copy, k, array.get(copy, bestIdx))
                array.set(copy, bestIdx, tmp)
        cutoff := array.get(copy, limit - 1)
    cutoff


// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 5. EXECUTION & ARRAY MANAGEMENT
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if not na(ph)
    if not filter_overlap or not is_overlapping(ph, atr, true)
        array.push(levels, create_level(ph, true, atr))

if not na(pl)
    if not filter_overlap or not is_overlapping(pl, atr, false)
        array.push(levels, create_level(pl, false, atr))

// Cap total stored zones
if array.size(levels) > max_zones
    int to_remove = array.size(levels) - max_zones
    for i = 0 to to_remove - 1
        SnRLevel old_lvl = array.shift(levels)
        line.delete(old_lvl.l_main)
        line.delete(old_lvl.l_sl)
        linefill.delete(old_lvl.f_zone)
        label.delete(old_lvl.lbl)


// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 6. UPDATE, BREAK & DISPLAY LOGIC
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
active_res     = 0
active_sup     = 0
visible_res    = 0
visible_sup    = 0
float top_res_pct = 0.0   // shared % of the top resistance zone (for dashboard)
float top_sup_pct = 0.0   // shared % of the top support zone

// --- Step 1: extend lines, detect breaks ---
if array.size(levels) > 0
    for i = array.size(levels) - 1 to 0
        SnRLevel lvl = array.get(levels, i)
        if lvl.is_active
            line.set_x2(lvl.l_main, time)
            line.set_x2(lvl.l_sl,   time)
            label.set_x(lvl.lbl,    time)
            label.set_y(lvl.lbl,    lvl.price)

            if lvl.is_sell
                active_res += 1
            else
                active_sup += 1

            bool broken = false
            if lvl.is_sell
                if close > lvl.sl_price
                    broken := true
            else
                if close < lvl.sl_price
                    broken := true

            if broken
                lvl.is_active := false
                if not show_bk
                    line.delete(lvl.l_main)
                    line.delete(lvl.l_sl)
                    linefill.delete(lvl.f_zone)
                    label.delete(lvl.lbl)
                    array.remove(levels, i)
                else
                    line.set_color(lvl.l_main,     color.new(color.gray, 60))
                    line.set_style(lvl.l_main,     line.style_dotted)
                    line.set_color(lvl.l_sl,       color.new(color.gray, 80))
                    linefill.set_color(lvl.f_zone, color.new(color.gray, 92))
                    label.delete(lvl.lbl)

// --- Step 2: gather active zones into per-side buckets ---
// We collect (index, raw_score) pairs, sort to find top-N,
// then compute softmax-style shared probabilities that sum to 100%.

var array<int>   sell_idx    = array.new_int()
var array<float> sell_scores = array.new_float()
var array<int>   buy_idx     = array.new_int()
var array<float> buy_scores  = array.new_float()

array.clear(sell_idx)
array.clear(sell_scores)
array.clear(buy_idx)
array.clear(buy_scores)

if array.size(levels) > 0
    for i = 0 to array.size(levels) - 1
        SnRLevel lvl = array.get(levels, i)
        if lvl.is_active
            if lvl.is_sell
                array.push(sell_idx,    i)
                array.push(sell_scores, lvl.raw_score)
            else
                array.push(buy_idx,    i)
                array.push(buy_scores, lvl.raw_score)

// --- Step 3: for each side, pick top-N, compute shared %, apply visuals ---
f_apply_side(array<int> idxs, array<float> scores, int n_show) =>
    int sz = array.size(idxs)
    if sz == 0
        [0, 0.0]
    else
        // Sort indices descending by score (selection sort on parallel arrays)
        sidx    = idxs.copy()
        sscores = scores.copy()
        for k = 0 to sz - 1
            int bestK = k
            if k < sz - 1
                for j = k + 1 to sz - 1
                    if array.get(sscores, j) > array.get(sscores, bestK)
                        bestK := j
            if bestK != k
                int   ti = array.get(sidx, k)
                float ts = array.get(sscores, k)
                array.set(sidx,    k,     array.get(sidx,    bestK))
                array.set(sscores, k,     array.get(sscores, bestK))
                array.set(sidx,    bestK, ti)
                array.set(sscores, bestK, ts)

        // Hide zones outside top-N
        int limit = math.min(n_show, sz)
        if sz > limit
            for k = limit to sz - 1
                SnRLevel lvl = array.get(levels, array.get(sidx, k))
                f_hide_zone(lvl)

        // Sum of scores across visible zones (for proportional split)
        float score_sum = 0.0
        for k = 0 to limit - 1
            score_sum += array.get(sscores, k)

        // Compute shared % and apply visuals; track top zone's pct for dashboard
        float top_pct = 0.0
        for k = 0 to limit - 1
            int   zi    = array.get(sidx, k)
            float sc    = array.get(sscores, k)
            float pct   = score_sum > 0 ? math.round(sc / score_sum * 1000.0) / 10.0 : math.round(100.0 / limit * 10.0) / 10.0
            bool  is_top = k == 0
            SnRLevel lvl = array.get(levels, zi)
            lvl.disp_pct := pct
            array.set(levels, zi, lvl)
            f_apply_zone(lvl, pct, is_top)
            if is_top
                top_pct := pct
        [limit, top_pct]

int  vis_res_n  = 0
int  vis_sup_n  = 0

if limit_display
    [vr, trp] = f_apply_side(sell_idx, sell_scores, display_count)
    vis_res_n  := vr
    top_res_pct := trp
    [vs, tsp] = f_apply_side(buy_idx,  buy_scores,  display_count)
    vis_sup_n  := vs
    top_sup_pct := tsp
else
    [vr2, trp2] = f_apply_side(sell_idx, sell_scores, array.size(sell_idx))
    vis_res_n   := vr2
    top_res_pct := trp2
    [vs2, tsp2] = f_apply_side(buy_idx,  buy_scores,  array.size(buy_idx))
    vis_sup_n   := vs2
    top_sup_pct := tsp2

visible_res := vis_res_n
visible_sup := vis_sup_n


// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 7. DASHBOARD
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
var table dash = table.new(dash_pos, 3, 5,
     bgcolor=color.new(#0b1220, 15),
     border_width=1,
     border_color=color.new(#38bdf8, 60),
     frame_color=color.new(#1e3a5f, 40),
     frame_width=1)

if barstate.islast and show_dash
    color hdr_bg  = color.new(#1e3a5f, 30)
    color row_bg1 = color.new(#111827, 20)
    color row_bg2 = color.new(#172033, 20)
    color c_muted = color.new(#94a3b8, 0)
    color c_txt   = color.new(#e5e7eb, 0)

    // Row 0: Header
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "LIQUIDITY ZONES", text_color=c_txt,   bgcolor=hdr_bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, "[QUANT]",          text_color=#38bdf8, bgcolor=hdr_bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(dash, 2, 0, limit_display ? "Top " + str.tostring(display_count) + " per side" : "All zones",
         text_color=c_muted, bgcolor=hdr_bg, text_size=size.tiny)

    if show_count
        // Row 1: Resistance
        table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "Resistance",
             text_color=c_muted, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 1, str.tostring(visible_res) + " shown / " + str.tostring(active_res) + " active",
             text_color=c_res, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 2, 1, "★ " + (visible_res > 0 ? str.tostring(top_res_pct, "#.1") + "%" : "N/A"),
             text_color=c_top, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)

        // Row 2: Support
        table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "Support",
             text_color=c_muted, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 2, str.tostring(visible_sup) + " shown / " + str.tostring(active_sup) + " active",
             text_color=c_sup, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 2, 2, "★ " + (visible_sup > 0 ? str.tostring(top_sup_pct, "#.1") + "%" : "N/A"),
             text_color=c_top, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)

        // Row 3: Total
        table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "Total Active",
             text_color=c_muted, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 3, str.tostring(active_res + active_sup) + " zones",
             text_color=c_txt,  bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.merge_cells(dash, 1, 3, 2, 3)

        // Row 4: Mode
        table.cell(dash, 0, 4, "Mode",
             text_color=c_muted, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 4, limit_display ? "Top " + str.tostring(display_count) + " per side" : "Show All",
             text_color=#38bdf8, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.merge_cells(dash, 1, 4, 2, 4)
    else
        table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "★ Top Resistance",
             text_color=c_top, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 1, visible_res > 0 ? str.tostring(top_res_pct, "#.1") + "%" : "N/A",
             text_color=c_top, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.merge_cells(dash, 1, 1, 2, 1)

        table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "★ Top Support",
             text_color=c_top, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 2, visible_sup > 0 ? str.tostring(top_sup_pct, "#.1") + "%" : "N/A",
             text_color=c_top, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.merge_cells(dash, 1, 2, 2, 2)

        table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "Visible",
             text_color=c_muted, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 3, str.tostring(visible_res) + "R  " + str.tostring(visible_sup) + "S",
             text_color=c_txt, bgcolor=row_bg1, text_size=size.small)
        table.merge_cells(dash, 1, 3, 2, 3)

        table.cell(dash, 0, 4, "Mode",
             text_color=c_muted, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(dash, 1, 4, limit_display ? "Top " + str.tostring(display_count) + " per side" : "Show All",
             text_color=#38bdf8, bgcolor=row_bg2, text_size=size.small)
        table.merge_cells(dash, 1, 4, 2, 4)

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// END OF Structural Liquidity Zones [QUANT]
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
